_description: E-069 cone codec UNDER THE FROZEN PROTOCOL (PROTOCOL_RESET §3.1, Chris 2026-08-30: train ≤ 2020, test 2021–2024, no gap; the two development blocks 2008–2009 and 2016–2017 held out in the same codec, exactly as E-068's f4r2-40M-terminal). Identical to f4r3-cone-7M.json in every field but one: holdout_years = 2008,2009,2016,2017,2021,2022,2023,2024, so the cone codec never trains on the terminal years and its z can carry a terminal-test number; f4r3-cone-7M.json (default holdout 2009,2017,2023 — the interspersed DEVELOPMENT split) stays as the recipe #537's first H1 reading was taken under and is not a recipe for any published level. Chris, 2026-09-03: 'I thought we're holding out 2021-2024, training on everything including 2020' — this file is that. E-069 the cone-native codec itself — ConeMAE, the encoder that reads the INNER DEPENDENCY CONE (the lag-0 3x3 patch plus, per channel, a sunflower of dots at lags 1-6 pentads whose reach follows that channel's physics) instead of one snapshot, so a displacement can be inside the embedding rather than rebuilt from compressed codes downstream. This is the recipe f4r3-cone-5M.json said it could not be: every cone flag is now a `# recipe-only:` key of .github/workflows/ml-train.yml, consumed exactly once in the Train step's cone branch, so naming this recipe with `window: recipe:f4r3-cone-7M,cone` runs ml/train_cone.py with this geometry and nothing is left to a dispatch field somebody forgot. Geometry: Perceiver, 64 latents x d_model 256 x 6 blocks, 8 heads, decoder 256 x 2, Gaussian head, auxiliary loss through the decoder's full memory at weight 0.25 (the headline term always goes through z alone), 256 dot queries per anchor, future lags 1 and 2, inner window L_in = 6 pentads = 30 days. d_z 32 and batch 256 match the f4r2 codec family so a cone z and a snapshot z are the same width. cone_velocity_probe is true because a codec trained without H1's read-out is a run that answers nothing; cone_snapshot_ablation is TRUE here: H1 is read as the cone codec's velocity R-squared AGAINST its own L_in = 0 snapshot twin (E-069 handover section 6), and a run without the twin cannot answer H1 at all; the twin roughly doubles the wall clock, which is the price of a readable number. HEAD_PROBE IS 'true' EXPLICITLY as every recipe states it (ml/CLAUDE.md section 3: unpooled is the verdict), even though a cone run skips the probe phase entirely: the key records what the configuration says, and scripts/probes_run.sh is what decides that this run has no Z to probe.
_provenance: Created 2026-09-03 after #537 (seed 0, development split) was already running; nothing has been measured under this recipe yet. Seeds 0, 1, 2 of the E-069 level are dispatched under THIS recipe; #537 is a development reading. Holding out eight of 43 years costs about a fifth of the training bins plus the 6-bin shadows (E-068's note); the pool size is printed by the trainer and should be recorded here when the first run lands.
